The giant green dragon of Crandor, Elvarg was awoken on the island by an adventurer and anyone nearby soon suffered her wrath. One person she didn't kill was Melzar. A pretty unforgettable chap.

Quest: Dragon Slayer

Combat: Possibly one of the most famous dragons to ever live, Elvarg attacks with a mixture of melee and dragon fire breath. You better have a anti-dragonbreath shield with you if you want to limit the damage you receive.
